headline: US Gulf-to-China Tanker Freight Rates Surpass $60M Amid Geopolitical Strain
summary: Charter rates for oil tankers on the route from the U.S. Gulf Coast to China have exceeded $60 million, more than tripling since tensions between the U.S. and Iran escalated in late February, curbing shipping demand.
why: Tanker charter rates are a vital component of global crude oil arbitrage, determining the economic viability of moving crude across the Atlantic and Pacific basins.

impacts.name: Crude Oil Tanker Shipping
impacts.why: Tripled tanker rates sharply elevate freight earnings for ship operators on long-haul voyages.
